mapper.sql: id, name, duration_months AS durationMonths, bonus_months AS bonusMonths, price, price_per_month AS pricePerMonth, description, status, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM xray_packet ORDER BY sort_order ASC, duration_months ASC
SELECT FROM xray_packet WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, duration_months ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xray_packet (name, duration_months, bonus_months, price, price_per_month, description, status, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{durationMonths}, #{bonusMonths}, #{price}, #{pricePerMonth}, #{description}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE xray_packet SET name = #{name}, duration_months = #{durationMonths}, bonus_months = #{bonusMonths}, price = #{price}, price_per_month = #{pricePerMonth}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
